findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now an uninstantiable abstract class
findings.body: `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` now subclasses `StatefulDetectorHandler` with an empty body. That base class has abstract members: `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and the newly added `build_occurrence_and_event_data`. Calling `group_type.detector_handler(self)` in `Detector.detector_handler` for a `metric_alert_fire` detector will raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class`. `process_detectors` does not catch it. Before this change the handler was concrete and returned an empty result. A detector of this type would now crash processing instead of being a harmless no-op. Keep the stub concrete (return `{}` from `evaluate`), or implement the abstract methods.

findings.title: evaluate docstring still says it returns a list
findings.body: The docstring of `StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate` says it "returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`". The method now returns a dict keyed by group key, which is the point of this PR's signature change. The docstring should be updated.
